// Sign-up, sign-in and sessions for this project's users. Generated by Tessery.
// Users live in the connected Postgres. The first account to sign up becomes an admin.
import Fastify, { type FastifyReply } from 'fastify'
import pg from 'pg'
import { randomBytes, scrypt as scryptCallback, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto'
import { config } from './config.js'
import { sessionFrom, signSession } from './session.js'

const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: config.dependencies['__DB_ENV__'], max: 10 })
const SESSION_DAYS = 7

function scrypt(password: string, salt: Buffer): Promise<Buffer> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => scryptCallback(password, salt, 64, (err, key) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(key))))
}

async function hashPassword(password: string): Promise<string> {
  const salt = randomBytes(16)
  return `scrypt$${salt.toString('base64')}$${(await scrypt(password, salt)).toString('base64')}`
}

async function checkPassword(password: string, stored: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const [, salt, hash] = stored.split('$')
  if (!salt || !hash) return false
  const want = Buffer.from(hash, 'base64')
  const got = await scrypt(password, Buffer.from(salt, 'base64'))
  return got.length === want.length && timingSafeEqual(got, want)
}

async function migrate(): Promise<void> {
  for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
    try {
      await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS auth_users (
        id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
        email text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        name text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        role text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user',
        password_hash text NOT NULL,
        created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
      )`)
      return
    } catch (e) {
      if (attempt >= 30) throw e
      console.error(`database not ready (${(e as Error).message}), retrying in 2s`)
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000))
    }
  }
}

interface User { id: string; email: string; name: string; role: string }

function startSession(reply: FastifyReply, user: User, secure: boolean) {
  const token = signSession({ sub: user.id, email: user.email, role: user.role }, SESSION_DAYS * 24 * 3600)
  reply.header('set-cookie', `session=${token}; HttpOnly; Path=/; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=${SESSION_DAYS * 24 * 3600}${secure ? '; Secure' : ''}`)
  return { user, token }
}

const EMAIL = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/

await migrate()
const app = Fastify({ logger: true })
const secure = (proto: unknown) => proto === 'https'

app.get('/healthz', async () => ({ status: 'ok' }))

app.post('/signup', async (req, reply) => {
  const { email, password, name } = (req.body ?? {}) as Record<string, string | undefined>
  const clean = String(email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase()
  if (!EMAIL.test(clean)) return reply.code(400).send({ error: 'invalid', field: 'email', detail: 'enter a valid email address' })
  if (String(password ?? '').length < 8) return reply.code(400).send({ error: 'invalid', field: 'password', detail: 'use at least 8 characters' })
  try {
    const r = await pool.query<User>(
      `INSERT INTO auth_users (email, name, password_hash, role)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth_users) THEN 'user' ELSE 'admin' END)
       RETURNING id, email, name, role`,
      [clean, String(name ?? '').trim(), await hashPassword(String(password))],
    )
    return reply.code(201).send(startSession(reply, r.rows[0], secure(req.headers['x-forwarded-proto'])))
  } catch (e) {
    if ((e as { code?: string }).code === '23505') return reply.code(409).send({ error: 'already_exists', detail: 'an account with this email exists; sign in instead' })
    throw e
  }
})

app.post('/login', async (req, reply) => {
  const { email, password } = (req.body ?? {}) as Record<string, string | undefined>
  const r = await pool.query<User & { password_hash: string }>('SELECT id, email, name, role, password_hash FROM auth_users WHERE email = $1', [String(email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase()])
  const row = r.rows[0]
  if (!row || !(await checkPassword(String(password ?? ''), row.password_hash))) return reply.code(401).send({ error: 'invalid_credentials', detail: 'wrong email or password' })
  const { password_hash: _, ...user } = row
  return startSession(reply, user, secure(req.headers['x-forwarded-proto']))
})

app.post('/logout', async (_req, reply) => {
  reply.header('set-cookie', 'session=; HttpOnly; Path=/; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=0')
  return reply.code(204).send()
})

app.get('/me', async (req, reply) => {
  const s = sessionFrom(req.headers)
  if (!s) return reply.code(401).send({ error: 'unauthorized' })
  const r = await pool.query<User>('SELECT id, email, name, role FROM auth_users WHERE id = $1', [s.sub])
  return r.rows[0] ?? reply.code(401).send({ error: 'unauthorized' })
})

await app.listen({ host: '0.0.0.0', port: config.port })
